text: Because language is a communication tool — I think languages are communication tools.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: If you can speak another language, you can communicate with more people.

speaker: A

text: Maybe you have some other ability that can solve their needs, or at least you could teach others who want to learn this language.

text: So of course it helps at work — well, at some work, it depends on what you do.

speaker: A
